subject: Clarify PO mandate and temporary onboarding lane for HeliosForge pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@heliosforge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliosforge.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding details for short pilot — PO question

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move quickly on a 6-week pilot (50k tokens / week estimate) but our procurement requires a purchase order number to open a vendor in our ERP. For a short pilot we usually do an invoice-only path — is Redwood able to accept invoices without a PO for this engagement? If not, what additional paperwork or evidence would you need to approve a temporary no-PO exception?

I've attached our vendor intake form (stub) and our procurement contact looped.

Attachments: helios_onboarding_form.pdf

Best,
Sofia Marin
Head of Partnerships
HeliosForge
sofia.marin@heliosforge.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@heliosforge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding details for short pilot — PO question

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: we can accommodate an invoice-only lane for short pilots, but we need a minimal evidence pack and an internal approval exception so Finance is comfortable. To move fast, please return the completed onboarding form (you already attached a stub — perfect) and upload the SOC 2 summary or the attestation of controls. Once we have that, I can request a temporary exception (30 days) from Finance and Procurement leads.

For transparency, I've looped in Laura (Finance) and Priyom (Sales Ops) so we can get an approvals path documented. Expected timeline after docs submitted: 24–48 hours for internal review, then an exception memo if approved. If we get approvals, you'll receive instructions for invoicing without a PO and the temporary vendor ID.

Attachments requested: helios_soc2_summary.pdf (or equivalent)

Next steps: Sofia — can you confirm you can share SOC 2 summary and the signed SOW draft?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding details for short pilot — PO question

Markus, Priyom —

Finance will approve a one-off invoice-only arrangement under the following controls:
- Vendor identity verified (W-9 / tax docs or non-US equivalent)
- Limited credit window: invoices net 15, capped at the pilot estimate (not to exceed $8k/week for the 6-week pilot)
- SOC 2 Type II summary or security questionnaire where there are gaps documented
- PO-exception memo signed by Finance lead and Procurement lead (I will prepare the memo once docs are in)

If HeliosForge can provide the SOC 2 summary and the completed onboarding form, we can prepare the memo and issue a temporary vendor ID within 48 hours. We will need the SOW to include the billing cadence (monthly or at milestone) to set invoice caps.

Grace — if you can confirm any red flags on the intake form/security side, flag here.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@heliosforge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliosforge.com
Date: 2027-06-07T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding details for short pilot — PO question

Hi Markus — thanks, all. Attached: SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a signed SOW draft that states monthly billing at milestone (invoice at completion of weeks 3 and 6). Also included our standard vendor tax form.

Attachments: helios_soc2_summary.pdf, helios_sow_draft.pdf

Comments: we prefer net 30, but agree to net 15 for the pilot if that helps speed approval. Please let us know if any additional evidence is required and we'll prioritize.

Looking forward to kickoff.

—Sofia
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@heliosforge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-07T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding details for short pilot — PO question (Approval pending)

Sofia —

Received everything, thanks. Laura will circulate the exception memo for signatures. Quick note on billing: Finance accepts Helios' net 30 request for this pilot but will triage payment priority at net 15 if invoice caps are exceeded. We'll issue an internal vendor ID and a temporary instruction document for invoicing without PO once approvals are collected.

I'll mark this thread as approved pending the signed memo (expected within 24 hours). Priyom — please add the exception to the deal in HubSpot (HS-4578) and attach the evidence pack.

Markus
